title: Calvin's Thirty days to live modpack
description: This is a custome modpack inspired by Calvin's video '30 Days until the sun DESTROYS the world..'
body:
⚠️ Important:
For an experience closer to the original inspiration, you can optionally install the Thirty Days to Live mod separately, as it is not included in this modpack.

This modpack is my attempt to recreate the cinematic Minecraft experience I saw from Calvin.

After watching one of his videos, I really liked how immersive and atmospheric the game felt, so I tried to track down the same mods and settings he used. I couldn’t find everything, but I got pretty close and spent time tweaking things (especially shaders) to match that style.

What this modpack does:

Makes Minecraft look more cinematic and atmospheric
Improves lighting, colors, and overall visuals
Creates a more immersive and realistic vibe

What to expect:

A focus on visuals rather than heavy gameplay changes
Works best with shaders (Nostalgia shader recommended)
A simple way to get that cinematic look without setting everything up yourself

Resource Pack (Full Grass) (optional, if you want full experience)
To get the full grass resource pack used in this modpack, download it here:
https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/#
Or instant download:
https://vanillatweaks.net/share#Vd8oqU

Why I made this:

I saw people asking what mods and shaders were used, so instead of everyone searching for everything themselves, I put this together to make it easier.

Note!

This modpack is inspired by Calvin’s content, but is not official or affiliated.
